purpose: 天南（docs/WORLD_EXPANSION.md 阶段二）所缺的图。放到 target 路径即自动接入；地点整屏图画好后从 tests/art_smoke.gd 的 PENDING_LOCATIONS 删去对应地点。
style: Use case: illustration-story. Production art for 凡途, an original Chinese cultivation 2D RPG. Style: CLEAR dark hand-drawn ink outlines, flat opaque color areas, restrained two-tone cel shading, simplified shapes and expressive illustrated faces, matching Chinese 2D cultivation game art. Muted jade, dusty teal, warm ivory, restrained gold; for 天南 add warm maple red, ember orange and soot grey as accents. No photorealism, realistic skin/textile, 3D, cinematic rendering, text, labels, UI, watermark.

assets.subject: 天南舆图：西北是赤霄门（建在火脉上的山门，炉烟不断），中部是赤枫岭（四季火红的枫林，地下有火脉与熔窟口），东南是南明坊市（朱楼长街，坊西头一座传送阵）。北边一条远路翻过群山通回青云山周边。
assets.prompt: Top-down illustrated regional map in the same painted style as the existing 青云山周边 map (assets/art/map/region_qingyun.png), 16:10. Place landmarks at these relative positions so code-drawn nodes sit on them: 赤霄门 sect gate at (0.16, 0.24) on a mountain ridge with forge smoke; 赤枫岭 red maple ridge at (0.36, 0.42) with a glowing fissure; 南明坊市 market street at (0.56, 0.66) with a small stone teleport circle on its west side. Leave the right third calm (sky, river, haze) for the route window. No text, no node markers, no roads drawn as UI lines.

assets.subject: 南明坊市：地火映街，千炉不熄。天南最热闹的坊市，坐落在赤霄门脚下。万宝楼的分号占了半条街，器铺多半挂着赤霄门的旗；坊市西头的传送阵直通云溪坊市。
assets.prompt: Wide landscape 16:9 full-screen environment with generous sky height, foreground and readable architectural focal points. NO characters. Left-center landmarks: a three-storey vermilion 万宝楼 with lanterns, forge shops with red banners and glowing furnace mouths, a stone teleport circle at the far left; quiet right side for menu overlay. No banner framing.

assets.subject: 赤枫岭：枫叶如火，地气蒸腾。地下有火脉经过，枫林四季皆红，火性灵草长得比别处旺；枫林深处的山壁裂开一道热风扑面的熔窟口。
assets.prompt: Wide landscape 16:9 full-screen environment. NO characters. A ridge of flame-red maples on warm grey rock, faint heat shimmer, small clusters of red flowers in rock cracks; left-center a dark fissure in the cliff breathing orange glow; quiet right side for menu overlay.

assets.subject: 赤霄门：炉火映天，剑出赤霄。天南五宗之一，以火法与炼器闻名，山门建在一道火脉之上，器坊的炉火据说三百年未曾熄过。

assets.subject: 长青谷：四时长青，百草成园。天南五宗之一，长于灵植与丹药，丹坊的药香终年不散。
